description: This file defines the API router for managing data assets in a backend API, including endpoints for creating, retrieving, validating, and approving data assets. It uses FastAPI framework components and depends on various services to handle business logic related to data assets.

methods.name: create_data_asset( request: CreateDataAssetRequest, current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: API endpoint to create a new data asset with standardized metadata, utilizing the DataAssetService.

methods.name: get_data_asset( data_asset_id: str, current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve details of a specific data asset by ID, including latest validation info.

methods.name: trigger_validation( data_asset_id: str, request: TriggerValidationRequest, current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: API endpoint to trigger a validation run for a specified data asset.

methods.name: approve_data_asset( data_asset_id: str, request: ApproveDataAssetRequest, current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: API endpoint to approve or reject a data asset, with e-signature and SoD validation.
